whatsappMessage:
Hi Team AJ Fitness Hub,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.6★ reviews from 245 members in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur location integration integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://ajfitnesshub-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team AJ Fitness Hub, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your strong 4.6★ reputation in Rajapur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
